title: Rudaad Karbala Ki Zainab
body:
Zainab ko dooor jab Aya nazar madina,
Aa'nkho'n Me Gammka EK EK Manzer Ubharr ke Ayaa,
Khud ko Gira k -(2) Maa ki markhad pa sar ko rakkha,
ansoo'n Baha Baha kar pardne lagi Ye Nouha,
Rudaad Karbala ki Zainab Suna Rahi hai,
Durrun k neel Amma tumko dikha rahi hai.
Rudaad Karbala Ki ZAINAB (SA) Suna Rahi Haiâ€¦.4
1) Ashur Ka Wo Suraj Karbo Bala Me Nikla,
Charo'n Taraf Se Amma BaadeÂ  Khizan Ghera,
Amma Tumara Gulshan Ek DoÂ  Pahar Me Ujjdaa.
Rudaad Karbala Ki ZAINAB (SA) Suna Rahi Haiâ€¦..2
2) Amma Tumare Bachche Seh Rooz K Thay Pyaase,
Wo Pyaas Ka Alam Murjha Gaye Thay Chahe Re,
Paherey Lage Howe Thay Darriya Pa Zalimo'n K..
Rudaad Karbalaef Ki ZAINAB (SA) Suna Rahi Haiâ€¦..2
3) Iss Tarha Lashe QASIM (a.s) Tukdu'n Me Batt Chuki Thi,
Khaimo Me Me Laye Bhaiya Osko Bana K Gatthe Di,
Khoo'n Roo Rahi Thi Aa'nkhe'n Oss Waqth Bewa Maa Ki..
Rudaad Karbala Ki ZAINAB (SA) Suna Rahi Haiâ€¦..2
4) Jab Bangaya Nishana BESHEER (ASWAS) hurmala (LA)Â  Ka,
Roya Har EK Zarra Maidan-E-Karbala Ka,
ASGHAR (ASAWS) K Khoo'n Me Dooba Chehra SHAH E HUDA (ASWS) Ka
Rudaad Karbala Ki ZAINAB (SA) Suna Rahi Haiâ€¦..2
5) Barchi Jo Kha Ke Tardpi AKBAR (a.s) Ki NawÂ  Jawani,
Do Gaam Chalna Payee SHBBIR (ASWS) Ki Zayifi,
Madar Ke Dil Ki Hasrath Ashko'n Me Dhal K Niklii.
Rudaad Karbala Ki ZAINAB (SA) Suna Rahi Haiâ€¦..2
6) Katt Karr Gire Zami'n Par GHAZI (ASWS) Ke Doono Shane,
Baitha Zami'n Pa BHAIYA (ASWS) Apni Kamar Jhukaye,
EHLE HARAM (ASWS) Pa Amma Gam K Pahaard Toootey.
Rudaad Karbala Ki ZAINAB (SA) Suna Rahi Haiâ€¦..2
7) Teeru'n Pa Teen Saa Ath BHAI (ASWAS) Ka Jisme Athhar,
Sheh Ragg Pa Kund Khanjer Siney Pa Tha sitamgar (LA),
Amma Main Deyk Ti Thi Wo Dil Kharaash Manzer.
Rudaad Karbala Ki ZAINAB (SA) Suna Rahi Haiâ€¦..2
8) Ghar Lutt Gaye Hamare Amma Wo Shaam Ayeee,
Ham Hogaye Khule SAR Aa'ndhee Chali Sitam Ki,
Tashheer Sarba Rehna Amma Howi Hamari.
Rudaad Karbala Ki ZAINAB (SA) Suna Rahi Haiâ€¦..2
9) Zahid Likho Muqarrib Pardte Raho Wo Nouha,
Maa Ki Lahedd Par Rokarr ZAINAB (SA) Ne Jo Sunaya,
Sunn Karr Jise Zami'n Ka Ek Ek Zarraa Roya.
Rudaad Karbala Ki ZAINAB (SA) Suna Rahi Haiâ€¦.3
